title: Peru's PCM approves National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030
date_note: Both pages are dated 24 November; DPL News says the strategy was published that day in the official gazette El Peruano. The resolution text itself was not read.
org: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros (PCM), Peru
geo_basis: Lima, seat of the national government (PCM)
summary: Andina reports that Peru's Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros approved the Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2026-2030 through Resolución Ministerial N.º 384-2026-PCM. Andina says it aims to prevent cyberattacks, protect the systems essential services depend on and ensure a timely response. DPL News says it covers public administration entities, state-owned enterprises and other organisations under digital trust rules.
plain: Peru's government approved a national cybersecurity strategy for 2026 to 2030, which Andina says aims to protect the systems that essential services depend on.
exec: Andina and DPL News report that Peru's government set a national cybersecurity strategy for 2026-2030 covering public bodies and state-owned enterprises.

validation.note: Andina (state news agency) and DPL News (independent publisher) both report the approval under RM 384-2026-PCM; the resolution text in El Peruano was not read.

review.note: duplicate of peru-national-cybersecurity-strategy-2026-2030-2026-11 (same RM 384-2026-PCM event); set duplicate_of and merged Andina and DPL News sources into the earlier record
